criterion: ROADMAP dated proposal P1, stage 1 (2026-10-21): ReSTIR DI (Bitterli et al. 2020, spatiotemporal reservoir resampling; Lin, Kettunen and Wyman 2026 for the reuse refinements) on the CPU path tracer's v3 punctual lights. Stage 2, equal-time HDR FLIP on the RTX 4090 at 1080p, needs the GPU and is not in this step.
written: 2026-10-21, before any ReSTIR code and before any run

design.where: raw/renderer/rt_restir.hpp, src/renderer/rt_restir.cpp: direct light from PtScene::lights at each pixel's primary hit (pixel centre, unjittered), shaded by the v3 material evaluation, one shadow ray a pixel in every sampled mode

modes.exact: every light with its own shadow ray: the reference, deterministic
modes.uniform: one light chosen uniformly, weight N
modes.ris: resampled importance sampling: M candidates chosen uniformly, target p_hat = luminance of the unshadowed contribution f E |cos|, one survivor, W = (sum w_i / M) / p_hat(y)
modes.restir: ris reservoirs at every pixel, then one spatial pass: the pixel's own reservoir and k neighbours within r pixels, re-targeted at the pixel's own p_hat; unbiased normalisation 1/Z with Z the sum of M_i over reservoirs whose surface gives p_hat_i(y) > 0 (Bitterli et al. 2020, algorithm 6); visibility only in the final shading
modes.restir_biased: the same with 1/M normalisation (recorded, not gated)

design.scenes: retro_room with 96 point lights (test), and raw-hall nave with 128 point lights at 320 x 200 (CLI restir-di, the evidence run); lights placed by a seeded LCG inside the scene's bounding box, intensities log-uniform over a factor 30, a range on each

r1_exact_matches_tracer.what: exact against pathTraceCpu with maxBounces 1, no sky, no environment, on the same pixels
r1_exact_matches_tracer.bound: relative difference at most 1e-5 per pixel
r1_exact_matches_tracer.prediction: holds: the same sum by the same evaluation

r2_unbiased.what: the image mean over 256 seeds of uniform, ris and restir against exact
r2_unbiased.bound: each within 4 standard errors (from the spread of the 256 image means)

r2b_control.bound: must miss r2 by more than 10 standard errors
r2b_control.prediction: misses by orders of magnitude (it is off by a factor M)

r3_quality.what: single-frame relative RMSE against exact (luminance over covered pixels, mean of 16 seeds), equal shadow rays (one a pixel)
r3_quality.bound: restir at least 30% below uniform, on both scenes (the P1 stage 1 target)
r3_quality.prediction: holds; ris alone about 30 to 60% below uniform, restir lower again

r4_bias_recorded.prediction: a few percent dark at shadow edges

does_not_prove: Anything about time on a GPU (stage 2); temporal reuse (not in stage 1); quality with area or environment lights; that the 30% holds on scenes unlike these two.
